model.fields: X0 singlet plus X4,XL,XR real adjoint seed blocks; S2 gauge-singlet source
model.boundary: M_a^2=M_0^2 and mu_a=mu_0 at Lambda_seed under O(22)_seed
model.claim_boundary: The analytic gauge-breaking beta terms are model independent. Numerical g running uses a minimal Pati-Salam matter content; extra breaking multiplets change the numerical size.

one_loop_gauge_beta_functions.protected_relation: d ln(mu_a/M_a^2)/d ln Q = 0 at one-loop gauge order
one_loop_gauge_beta_functions.common_terms: O(22)-symmetric quartic and scalar terms cancel in adjoint/singlet ratios; non-O(22) scalar couplings would add model-dependent splitting.

scenario_results.scenario: O22 boundary imposed at matching scale
scenario_results.interpretation: No Pati-Salam running interval between equality boundary and mediator matching.
Because beta_ln(mu)=beta_ln(M^2), the ratio mu/M^2 is unchanged by gauge running at one loop.
The one-loop derivative expansion of a scalar bubble has this scaling; charged adjoint blocks are enhanced in the IR.
A tree-level inverse-mass kernel is suppressed because gauge running raises the charged seed masses toward the IR.
The local S mass term is logarithmically divergent and requires a counterterm; its finite sign and relative threshold are not fixed by the beta function alone.
Gauge factors cancel exactly at this order because M_a^2 and mu_a run identically.

main_conclusion: The exact one-loop seed RGEs do not select a universal suppressive or enhancing sign by themselves; the sign belongs to the definition of the induced mediator kernel. M_a^2 and mu_a receive identical gauge factors, so mu/M^2 and mu^2/M^4 are protected. The concrete loop-induced derivative kernel mu^2/M^2 is enhancing and gives N_eff about 23.73 across the current scale interval, producing a roughly 6.5% worst flavor error. Therefore the derivative-bubble realization is ruled out unless the O(22) equality is imposed within about 19% of the mediator matching scale or additional dynamics cancels the running. A protected auxiliary/composite realization based on mu/M^2 remains viable at one loop.
